stories.headline: Jensen Huang Left Off Trump's China Trip Delegation; Musk, Cook, Boeing CEO Invited

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was not invited to join President Trump on his China trip this week, while Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook, GE Aerospace's Larry Culp and Boeing's Kelly Ortberg will travel with the president.
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump has invited executives from some of the biggest U.S. companies — including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, BlackRock's CEO Larry Fink and Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg — to join his trip to China this week, according to a White House official. Notably absent from the attendees is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

key_facts.fact: A White House source said Huang was not invited because the trip is focused on agriculture and commercial aviation matters such as Boeing aircraft orders.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang did not get an invite because the White House wants to focus more on agriculture and aviation, Reuters reported. Nvidia has become a major geopolitical bargaining chip between the two superpowers.

key_facts.fact: Huang told CNBC the previous week he would gladly join if invited; he has identified China as a $50 billion opportunity for Nvidia AI chip sales.
key_facts.excerpt: His absence from the trip could potentially hinder his efforts to sell Nvidia's AI chips to China, a market he has identified as a $50 billion opportunity. This comes after Huang expressed his willingness to join the president on the anticipated trip.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's H200 chips were approved by Commerce in recent weeks under a 25% revenue-sharing arrangement, but Commerce Secretary Lutnick said on April 22 that no shipments had actually moved because Chinese buyers have not received permission from Beijing to import them.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump has developed a strong relationship with [Huang] since he has been in office and agreed to allow the company's H200 AI chips to be exported to China. But they have not yet been sold, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said on April 22nd, citing difficulties with Chinese companies getting permission to buy them from the Chinese government.

stories.headline: Nscale Secures $790M Debt Financing for Narvik AI Data Center in Norway

key_facts.fact: Nscale announced $790 million in additional debt financing committed by ABN AMRO, DNB, Eksfin, Nordea and SEB to develop its AI data center in Narvik, Norway — described as the country's largest AI infrastructure investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Nscale is pleased to announce an additional $790 million in financing – committed by ABN AMRO, DNB, Eksfin, Nordea and SEB – to reinforce the continued development of the AI data center in Narvik, Norway. This data center project is the largest AI infrastructure investment in Norway.

key_facts.fact: The package includes an additional $790 million accordion feature to fund a further 115 MW expansion at the Narvik campus.
key_facts.excerpt: The committed financing includes an additional $790 million uncommitted accordion feature to fund a further 115MW expansion at the Narvik AI data center.

key_facts.fact: The Narvik site was previously earmarked for OpenAI's Stargate Norway project; after that deal fell through, Nscale signed with Microsoft, which will rent Nvidia GPUs at the site.
key_facts.excerpt: The data centre was previously earmarked to house OpenAI's ambitious Stargate Norway AI data centre project. But instead, Nscale has signed a deal with existing customer Microsoft, which will rent Nvidia chips from Nscale at the site, after it was reported that OpenAI and Nscale failed to land a deal.

key_facts.fact: The Microsoft deal adds more than 30,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs to the Narvik campus, to be delivered by 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement adds more than 30,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs to Narvik campus, delivering high-performance AI compute capacity to Norway by 2027.

key_facts.fact: Nscale was valued at $14.6 billion earlier this year after a $2 billion Series C, and previously secured a $1.4 billion delayed-draw term loan in February 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Earlier this year, Nscale was valued at $14.6bn following a $2bn Series C funding round.

stories.headline: Baiju Bhatt's Cowboy Space Raises $275M Series B at $2B Valuation for Orbital Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space Corporation, founded by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt, announced a $275 million Series B at a $2 billion valuation led by Index Ventures, with participation from IVP, Blossom Capital, SAIC, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA and Interlagos.
key_facts.excerpt: Cowboy Space Corporation, the orbital infrastructure company founded by Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt, today announced $275M in Series B financing at a $2B valuation led by Index Ventures, with participation from new investors IVP, Blossom Capital, and SAIC, alongside existing investors Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, Interlagos and Baiju Bhatt.

key_facts.fact: The company, formerly known as Aetherflux since its 2024 founding, is rebranding alongside the raise and is building a constellation of LEO satellites where each upper stage of its purpose-built launch vehicle becomes a 1-megawatt data center in orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: The company, which operated as Aetherflux since its founding in 2024, is also unveiling its new name and brand... The rocket's upper stage and data center payload are designed as a single vehicle — not as a workhorse and its freight — eliminating redundant mass and optimizing power and compute delivered to orbit. In orbit, each upper stage becomes a 1-megawatt data center.

key_facts.fact: Cowboy Space had previously raised $80 million from Index, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz and NEA.
key_facts.excerpt: The company had previously raised $80 million from investors, including Index, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, and New Enterprise Associates.

key_facts.fact: The thesis: terrestrial data center capacity is straining under AI demand, and there aren't enough rockets to deliver compute payloads to orbit — Cowboy Space is vertically integrating launch vehicles, space-based solar power and in-orbit compute.
key_facts.excerpt: There aren't enough rockets for space data centers — Cowboy Space raised $275M to build them

stories.headline: Reliance to Get 900+ Acres in Andhra Pradesh for 1.5 GW Hyperscale AI Data Center

key_facts.fact: The Andhra Pradesh government has agreed in principle to allot more than 900 acres near Bhogapuram International Airport to Reliance Industries for what will be India's largest AI-ready hyperscale data center cluster at 1.5 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Reliance Industries Limited is set to receive more than 900 acres near Bhogapuram International Airport in Andhra Pradesh for establishing what is projected to be India's largest 1.5 GW AI-ready hyperscale data centre cluster.

key_facts.fact: The investment is valued at ₹1.6 lakh crore (~$19 billion), with formal clearance expected soon after approval from the State Investment Promotion Board.
key_facts.excerpt: The Andhra Pradesh Government has, in principle, agreed to allot three land parcels for the project, which has already secured approval from the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB). Formal clearance for the proposed investment of ₹1.6 lakh crore is expected soon.

key_facts.fact: Reliance requested ~360 acres for phase one and 635 acres for phase two, plus additional land for a cable landing station and desalination plant. Power will come from captive solar generation and battery energy storage.
key_facts.excerpt: Reliance has sought around 360 acres for the first phase and 635 acres for the second phase. The company has also requested additional land for a cable landing station and a desalination plant. Power requirements are expected to be met through captive solar generation and battery energy storage systems.

key_facts.fact: The Reliance project follows the groundbreaking of Google's $15 billion, 1 GW data center at Taruluvada near Visakhapatnam, being developed with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed investment comes shortly after the groundbreaking ceremony for Google's $15 billion, 1 GW AI-focused data centre at Taruluvada near Visakhapatnam, being developed in partnership with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel.

stories.headline: China's Robotera Raises Over $200M Led by SF Group to Scale Humanoid Robotics

key_facts.fact: Beijing-based Robotera raised over $200 million in a new round led by SF Group, with participation from HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse Investment, CICC Capital and several industrial partners including KENGIC, Dongfeng Asset Investment, ICBC Capital and funds affiliated with China Unicom.
key_facts.excerpt: Following its RMB 1 billion strategic round in March, robotics company ROBOTERA has raised over USD 200 million in a new financing round led by SF Group. The round also saw participation from leading financial investors including HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse Investment, CICC Capital, Jingming Capital, SparkEdge Capital, Luxin Venture Capital Group... alongside major industrial partners such as KENGIC, Dongfeng Asset Investment, ICBC Capital, and funds affiliated with China Unicom.

key_facts.fact: Robotera says it has reached the first product-market fit in embodied intelligence, with deployments across more than ten logistics centers in collaboration with China Post and SF Group; Q2 2026 saw thousand-unit deliveries with growth exceeding 300%.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has achieved the first product-market fit (PMF) in the embodied intelligence sector, with deployments across more than ten logistics centers in collaboration with China Post and SF Group. In Q2 2026, ROBOTERA initiated thousand-unit deliveries, with growth exceeding 300%.

key_facts.fact: Founded in August 2023 by Chen Jianyu, Robotera sells the L7 full-size bipedal humanoid (~171 cm), the STAR 1 model tested in the Gobi Desert and Great Wall, and the ERA-42 end-to-end embodied AI model.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in August 2023 by Chen Jianyu, Robotera is a humanoid robotics company. Its offers include: L7 (Full-Size Bipedal): Their flagship model, standing about 171 cm (5'7″) tall. STAR 1: A humanoid tested in extreme environments like the Gobi Desert and the Great Wall of China. ERA-42 Large Model: An end-to-end 'embodied AI' model.

stories.headline: Vbot Raises ~$73M Pre-A, Sets Consumer Embodied AI Funding Record in China

key_facts.fact: Chinese embodied AI startup Vbot closed a Pre-A round of nearly 500 million yuan (~$73 million), co-led by Oriental Fortune Capital, Huatai Zijin Investment and Fosun RZ Capital, with participation from SAIC Motor's Shangqi Capital. The company calls it the largest single-round consumer embodied intelligence funding to date.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese embodied AI startup Vbot announced the completion of a Pre-A funding round of nearly 500 million yuan ($73 million), marking another massive financing deal in the sector. The round was co-led by Oriental Fortune Capital, Huatai Zijin Investment, and Fosun RZ Capital, with participation from institutions including SAIC Motor's Shangqi Capital.

key_facts.fact: Vbot started shipping its first product — the Vbot Super Robot Dog — on May 8, with the first batch of 500 units mass-produced and now being delivered through WeChat mini-program and JD.com.
key_facts.excerpt: Alongside the new funding, the company has started deliveries of its first product, a super robot dog, with the first batch of 500 units already mass-produced and currently shipping.

key_facts.fact: Vbot plans to increase production capacity to more than 2,500 units per month in June and will begin development of a full-size humanoid robot, including an Agentic OS for embodied applications.
key_facts.excerpt: The company plans to increase its production capacity to more than 2,500 units in June to accelerate fulfilling pre-orders and further expand its market share, according to Vbot... The company's core objective for the next phase is to initiate the hardware development of full-size humanoid robots and build a world model covering general manipulation and mobility capabilities.

key_facts.fact: Vbot was founded in late 2024 by Dr. Yu Yinan, who previously led work in autonomous driving at Horizon Robotics, and produces its robot dog to automotive-industry standards with 5-hour battery life.

key_facts.fact: Yicai Global reports the round as part of a broader surge: Vbot, Lumos Robotics and Uncharted Dynamics together raised nearly 1 billion yuan (~$137 million) in fresh funding announced this week.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese companies Lumos Robotics, Vbot, and Uncharted Dynamics have secured billions of Chinese yuan, equivalent to hundreds of millions of US dollars from their latest funding rounds... with total funding reaching nearly CNY1 billion (USD137.2 million).

stories.headline: TerraVolt Signs 55,000 MMBTU/Day Natural Gas Deal for Idaho AI Data Center Campus

key_facts.fact: CalEthos and its subsidiary TerraVolt Infrastructure announced a firm natural gas supply agreement for 55,000 MMBTU per day to power a planned behind-the-meter onsite power plant for an AI data center campus in Southeast Idaho.
key_facts.excerpt: CalEthos, Inc. and its subsidiary TerraVolt Infrastructure, Inc. today announced the execution of an agreement with a top-tier natural gas marketing company for the FIRM supply to the Company of natural gas for TerraVolt's planned behind-the-meter onsite power plant. Under the terms of the agreement, the natural gas supplier will provide the Company with 55,000 MMBTU per day of natural gas.

key_facts.fact: The first phase of the campus is planned for 200-240 MW of power for data center customers, located on the Northwest Natural Gas Pipeline.
key_facts.excerpt: Joel Stone, Chairman and CEO of the Company, stated 'this agreement will provide fuel for the initial phase of our campus development, which is currently planned for 200MW to 240MW of power for data center customers, without impacting the local grid or increasing the cost of power to the local rate payers.'

key_facts.fact: CalEthos says the project aligns with President Trump's March 4, 2026 Ratepayer Protection Pledge, which requires technology companies to pay for the power infrastructure needed to support their expanding data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: the Company's planned data center campus aligns with President Trump's recent March 4, 2026 initiative, the Ratepayer Protection Pledge, which requires technology companies to pay for the power infrastructure needed to support their expanding data centers.
